<subject>Re: Atlas Strategic Partners</subject>
<body>
You need to contact whoever it is you are speaking to at Piedmont Power & Light and tell them we have never received a request to assign the financial instruments, and if they would like to send us one we will take a look at it.



	Theodore Gates
	06/13/2024 10:40 AM
		 
		 To: Bonnie Gardner
		 cc: 
		 Subject: Re: Atlas Strategic Partners

Hi Bonnie,
I didn't know if I forwarded this to you or not, but they are indeed marking up the financial instruments. Would you like for me to forward them to you?

Thanks
Theodore
